span.span: Reasoning Content: “The issue is that just removing the option block doesn’t give any speedup—the reference model also uses those parameters. The model still takes the same time because it’s using the same simulation parameters.”

Main work: The agent tests timesteps, solver settings, iteration counts, and XML changes. Some candidates fail to parse; faster ones do not meet the final-state tolerance. It also discovers errors in some of its comparison scripts.
Main work: The agent evaluates a model whose final state matches the reference, but whose runtime remains above the limit.
Main work: The agent continues searching without finding a configuration that passes both checks. It returns to a copy of the reference model.

Reasoning Content: “With the original reference model (t=0.002, iter=100), we get diff=0 but time is ∼\sim100% of reference. … The nearest working configuration is t=0.002 without any option tag (defaults) which gives diff=0 but time ∼\sim98–100%.”
